column1: # Which cattle deep history each replicate resumes from.
# A DEEP HISTORY is an independent original population + 30,000-tick burn-in +
# epochs 1-7, rescaled from Q=1 to Q=0.01 -- everything upstream of the
# end-of-epoch-7 handoff that E, L, F and G all resume from. Through the
# 5-replicate publication set every cattle replicate shared ONE of these
# (cattle_baseline_seed 20250303), so the cattle arms carried exactly one
# ancestral genealogy: 33,130 of 33,154 generations were common to all of them
# and only epochs 8-12 (24 generations) were simulated per replicate. Their
# replicate spread therefore sampled the terminal bottleneck and the trait draw,
# not the between-population variance the human arm's spread samples. This table
# is what makes that no longer true, and it is the record of which seeds were
# used to do it.
# KEYED BY REPLICATE, NEVER BY CATEGORY. E, L, F and G at the same replicate MUST
# share a deep history: that is what makes E-vs-F-vs-G at replicate r a comparison
# of selection regimes on ONE genealogy rather than three simulations differing in
# everything. One row per replicate rather than per block, so changing the block
# size later edits a column instead of the schema.
# Replicates 1-5 keep 20250303. That is not sentiment: 4 arms x 4 cattle
# categories x 5 replicates = 80 finished runs are named for the stage-1 files
# that history produced, and a stage-1 filename that moves is a run that has been
# orphaned. helpers/paths.cattle_baseline_segment is suppressed at this value for
# the same reason.
# Deep-history seeds keep the YYYYMMDD convention 20250303 already follows. They
# are 8-digit, so they cannot be confused with a stage-1 seed (2-3 digits), and
# they are < 2^32, so msprime's random_seed and the seed+1 used for the mutation
# overlay in farm_create_orig_pop_e2.py are both valid.
# ANALYSIS CONSEQUENCE. Four ancestries against the human arm's twenty means
# cattle replicates are NESTED within deep history and are not exchangeable.
# summarize_coloc pools replicates flat and its grouping key does not carry the
# deep history -- correctly, since these are replicates -- so a cattle interval
# computed that way is roughly sqrt(5) = 2.2x too narrow. Estimate cattle
# between-population variance at the BLOCK level (n=4), or state that it is not
# estimated.
# Columns
#   replicate             1..20; the key
#   cattle_baseline_seed  stage1_seed the deep-history chain was built at, and the
#                         `seed_` component of the handoff filename
#   handoff_file          the Q=0.01 end-of-epoch-7 checkpoint replicates resume
#                         from; must equal paths.stage1_cattle_baseline_handoff
#   built_from            config the chain was built from
# The MEASURED provenance (sha256, bytes, build date, git commit) is NOT here: it
# cannot be known until the chain has run, and preflight_repo refuses a dirty
# tree. It lives in <deep histories dir>/PROVENANCE.tsv, written by
# rebuild_cattle_deep_history.sh --collect.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
replicate
